findings.issue: An element of a packed uint32[] storage array inside a mapping is printed as raw slot arithmetic with a mask and a shift, and the index expression is repeated three times; the length of the same array prints as stor264[_param1].length.
findings.rule: For a dynamic array of w-bit elements (k = 256 / w per slot) at slot p, 'Mask(w, w * (i % k), stor[i / k + sha3(p)]) >> w * (i % k)' is element i; with p = sha3(key, n) it is storn[key][i] (here stor264[_param1][_param2 + idx]).
